provenance.paper_title: O-MARC: Omni Memory-Augmented Compression Distillation for Efficient Video Understanding

representation_paths.memory_component: compressed visual memory and temporally grounded audio anchors

evidence.paraphrase: OMAC preserves salient visual memory and aligned audio anchors in a compressed context.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 8): The full-paper lifecycle review found compressed visual memory and temporally grounded audio anchors fixed during downstream inference; query-conditioned access, preprocessing, or training-time changes were not counted as persistent deployed updates. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
